description: zuiris's method on the ecdsa.fail Leapfrog product line (Q1234-1244, Oct-Nov 2026). Each row moved the binding constraint with one structural mechanism: per-tick identities, a deeper shift alphabet, a pruned alphabet, record codes and packs. The tactics around it: priced failure spending, rebasing on a rival's freed resource with a same-day cap sweep, guard audits, declared nonce hunts. Use when a product-score line is stuck on small steps, when a rival frees wires or room, when choosing the next structural row on a walk-based point-add, when pricing a width trade or a failure spend, or when a new record or codec might have shadowed an older mechanism.
